glossary.definition: (A) "Attorney in fact" means a person designated as such by a durable power of attorney for health care executed pursuant to sections 1337.11 to 1337.17 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.60 to 3721.67 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3721.60 - Electronic monitoring in long-term care facilities definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Electronic monitoring device" means a surveillance instrument with a fixed position video camera or an audio recording device, or a combination thereof, that is installed in a resident's room and broadcasts or records activities or sounds occurring in the room.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.60 to 3721.67 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3721.60 - Electronic monitoring in long-term care facilities definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Guardian" has the same meaning as in section 2111.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.60 to 3721.67 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3721.60 - Electronic monitoring in long-term care facilities definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "Long-term care facility" has the same meaning as in section 3721.21 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3721.60 to 3721.67 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3721.60 - Electronic monitoring in long-term care facilities definitions.

glossary.definition:
(E) "Resident" means an individual who resides in a long-term care facility.
